svg.title: The steps of creating bills
svg.desc: After you pick the period, students and fees and press Create bills, the app checks first. If no bills exist for the period and no student is inactive, bills are created straight away. Otherwise you decide what happens. Skipping needs no approval; creating a second bill or deleting a bill with money paid needs approval.
